last_review.summary: The change meets AUTH-003-A acceptance criteria and architecture requirements. It adds a singleton, server-configured Supabase client; validates tokens through Supabase Auth; returns only the trusted user ID; consistently sanitizes authentication failures; introduces no token logging, persistence, database changes, Core access, or out-of-scope behavior; and modifies only allowed paths. Deterministic TypeScript build and Prisma validation both passed.

notes: No tests are executed by loop V2.
Do not connect autonomous agents to the production Supabase database.
Core does not exist yet; Auth defines stable seams/contracts but does not implement Core.
Auth->Core internal request auth is Noop in V1; future signed JWT is a pluggable strategy.
